chunks.title: Common Form / Non-Contentious Probate
chunks.quote: Identifies registry/common-form applications where the grant is sought without a live probate dispute.

chunks.title: Solemn Form / Contentious Probate
chunks.quote: Flags contentious probate proceedings where validity, entitlement or revocation must be litigated.

chunks.title: Registrar Route
chunks.quote: Covers applications or requisitions dealt with by the Probate Registry or Registrar subject to source verification.

chunks.title: Judge / Court Route
chunks.quote: Routes matters requiring summons, judge directions, contentious gateway or court order.

chunks.title: Personal Applicant vs Solicitor Application
chunks.quote: Separates personal applicant handling from solicitor-led applications and registry communication.

chunks.title: Grant Type and Entitlement
chunks.quote: Determines the proper grant and applicant priority before any form/template recommendation.

chunks.title: Probate to Executor
chunks.quote: Grant route where an executor named in the will applies.

chunks.title: Administration with Will Annexed
chunks.quote: Grant route where there is a will but no acting executor able/willing to prove it.

chunks.title: Intestate Administration
chunks.quote: Letters of administration route where no valid will is being proved.

chunks.title: Renunciation and Retraction
chunks.quote: Tracks renunciation of probate/administration and applications to retract renunciation.

chunks.title: Additional Administrator / Representative
chunks.quote: Covers joinder or addition of an administrator or representative.

chunks.title: Will Validity and Testamentary Evidence
chunks.quote: Evidence layer for execution, identity, condition, lost wills and rectification issues.

chunks.title: Due Execution and Attestation

chunks.title: Identity, Handwriting and Death Evidence

chunks.title: Plight, Condition and Alterations

chunks.title: Lost, Copy or Reconstructed Will

chunks.title: Rectification of Will
chunks.quote: Flags clerical error or instruction-misunderstanding rectification route.

chunks.title: Small Estate / Bank Release
